summary: A Holy damage priest: 31 Discipline (Power in Light, Twin Disciplines, Holy Precision, Power Infusion) and 17 Holy (Divine Fury, Searing Light) casting Smite and Holy Fire. Shipped as its own spec on its own hit-free gear, 17% behind Shadow at 180 s because Smite is a mana-hungry filler.
rotation: Pre-pull: Smite at -2 s that lands at the pull
Dark Sacrifice (Undead) below 40% mana; Power Infusion on cooldown; racials on cooldown
Inner Focus right before Holy Fire
Holy Fire whenever its DoT is down (keeps Power in Light up)
Shadow Word: Pain whenever it is down (9+ s left)
Devouring Plague whenever it is down (12+ s left) and mana is at least 20%
Rank 8 Smite while mana lasts the fight at 20 mana a second
consumes: Elixir of Holy Power (Elixir of Greater Firepower)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 36 spell power and 15 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Smite rank 8 looks partly un-retuned; held at rank 4's ratio to Era the build would be about +1.3%
No downrank penalty assumed for low Smite ranks (rank 3 would be +0.9 at 300 s but may be penalized)
Penance, Mind Blast and SW:Death dropped by the search (Penance: 385 mana for three 92-damage bolts)
Synthetic gear, Vestments of Conviction 2-piece only (4/5-piece +4.7)
Kreeg's Stout Beatdown left out as a Dire Maul item; Elixir of Sages left out by the one-crit-elixir ruling (+6.4)
Dark Sacrifice gives 1600 + Spirit mana (tooltip adds Spirit; client data says 1600)
